description: The signed-in catchy-me account: name, email, language, plan («тариф»: code, status, period end), briefs («брифы») left this period and when they renew, the free brief, the balance in whole credits (available = balance minus holds of running work) and the search limits (max leads per search). Call it first to know what the user can do: starting a search or an outreach needs a plan or credits, and each new setup spends one brief. [REST: GET /api/account, GET /api/config]
name: get_account
title: Account, plan and balance
